tests_scope: Actual unchanged CUDA probability/grouping/preprocessing helpers; Python mode validation and operand identity; all-row regression and NaN gates; fresh-API versus fixed-core orchestration; randomized timing and raw sample retention; CUPTI single-kernel capture counts and per-trial medians.
limitations: New full attention candidates have not run on Hopper locally. Compilation and helper tests do not establish their complete numerical correctness.
No H200 speedup or 22 ms achievement is claimed. Default remains vc15 pending same-session H200 comparison.
Instruction text equality excludes machine encodings and scheduling control bits; it is not latency evidence.
CUPTI kernel durations are profiler-active measurements; synchronized core API and full API times have separate scopes.
